skills.name: aura-agent-orchestration
skills.displayName: AURA Runtime Setup and Milestone Selection
skills.description: Prepare AURA, an on-device physical-AI agent (camera, microphone, memory and local LLM) for Arduino VENTUNO Q and Qualcomm IQ8, and pick the smallest milestone to run, without starting device services by default.
useCases: Set up the AURA on-device agent on my IQ8 board
Which AURA milestone should I build first: vision, speech, memory or agent?
Install only the AURA vision extra and run the tests
Show my AURA configuration and what optional components are missing
